name: tui-live-preview
description: Preview .tui.xaml files as real Terminal.Gui views, straight from the editor context menu.

tuiLivePreview.cliPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the preview CLI. Accepts a built `cli.exe`/`cli.dll`, or a `.csproj` (which is run with `dotnet run`). When empty, the extension searches the workspace for `cli/bin/*/net*/cli.exe` and falls back to `dotnet run --project cli/cli.csproj`.

enumDescriptions: Host the preview in the view's own app when that app references TuiPreview.Host, otherwise use the CLI.
Always host the preview in the view's own app; fail if it does not reference TuiPreview.Host.
tuiLivePreview.launchMode.markdownDescription: Where the preview runs. An app that references `TuiPreview.Host` and calls `TuiPreviewHost.TryRun(args, out int code)` first in `Main` hosts it itself: the extension builds the app, runs a copy of its output with `--tui-preview`, and the view compiles against exactly what the app runs with.

tuiLivePreview.className.markdownDescription: Override for the `--class` argument. When empty, it is read from the `x:Class` attribute of the XAML being previewed, and you are only prompted if that attribute is missing.

tuiLivePreview.width.description: Render width in columns. Ignored in interactive mode, which fills the terminal.

tuiLivePreview.height.description: Render height in rows. Ignored in interactive mode, which fills the terminal.

tuiLivePreview.ansi.description: Emit ANSI colour escapes in rendered output (sets TUI_ANSI=1).

tuiLivePreview.live.markdownDescription: Preview unsaved editor changes, not just what is on disk. The live buffer is mirrored to a scratch file that the preview watches, so edits appear without saving. Turn this off to always preview the last saved version, which is what you want when a rendered frame needs to be reproducible (CI, screenshots, a bug report).
